app.title: ScreenTextCopy
app.tagline: Capture text from anywhere on your screen
action.capture.hint: Select a region of the screen to read text from
result.empty: No text was found in the selected area.
translate.title: Translate to
mobile.title: Send to phone
mobile.instruction: Scan this QR code with your phone camera to receive the text.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ocrLanguages.hint: Choose the languages that appear on screen. Missing packs can be installed.
settings.hotkey.hint: Press this shortcut anytime to start capturing.
settings.overlayHotkey.hint: Press this to translate a region in a floating popup — great over games and videos.
settings.minimizeToTray: Keep running in the system tray when closed
settings.baseUrl.hint: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or a local server.
settings.apiKey.hint: Stored only on this computer. Leave empty for local servers that need no key.
settings.modelFailover: Automatically switch to another model if one times out
settings.proxyAddress.hint: e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:10808 or http://127.0.0.1:10809. Use this to route through a local VPN/proxy such as v2rayN.
settings.about.creator: Reza Kazemi Fathi
settings.about.openSource: This project is open source on GitHub — your support and stars mean a lot! ⭐
toast.emojiDropped: Emoji can't be recognized by OCR and were skipped
overlay.empty: No text found in the selected area
overlay.retry.hint: Click Retry, or press the overlay shortcut again, to translate once more.
langpack.title: Language packs
langpack.download.failed: Could not download the language pack. Check your connection.
error.timeout: The request timed out. Try another model or check your connection.
